tess_fin: Planning a small canary for NEW_RATECARD tomorrow 09:00 PT. 5% traffic, 2-hour canary window. Need billing-safe rollback and explicit grandfathering exclusions. @sam_billing @raj_sre @carmen_cs can you ack?
raj_sre: Ack. Ops request: implement a soft-fail fallback where any unrecognized meter_id routes to LEGACY_RATE and emit metric `billing.canary.meter_unmapped`.
sam_billing: On it. We need vendor mapping + checksum. If meter ids differ, invoices will split across skus and break thresholds. Requesting vendor CSV + sha256. Also want a dry-run invoice for the 12 grandfathered accounts.
carmen_cs: Confirming CS: those 12 enterprise customers must be in the `grandfather_exempt` list. If any test invoice shows NEW_RATE charged, we stop rollout immediately and open support tickets.
vendor_ali: I'll export CSV to s3://vendor-exports/new_ratecard_223333.csv and post sha256 in this thread. Format: meter_id, sku, cents_per_unit, effective_date.
tess_fin: Action items: 1) vendor_ali upload CSV+sha256 2) sam_billing run simulated invoices for exempt + 50 random PAYG 3) raj_sre add meter parity alert and fallback 4) carmen_cs sign off on exempt list.
sam_billing: Sim plan: ingest CSV -> build mapping table (`price_migration_v223`) with `grandfather_exempt` bool. Run reconcile script at 3x sample to catch bucketed tiers. ETA 2.5h after CSV. Example query: ```sql
-- reconcile sample
SELECT acct_id, SUM(amount_cents) AS cents FROM simulated_line_items WHERE meter_id IN ('mA1','mB2') AND run_tag='canary_223' GROUP BY acct_id;
```
raj_sre: I'll add a short-run healthcheck in the router: first 500 requests verify meter_id present in mapping. Emit Prometheus metric `billing.meter_missing_total`. If >0.2% in first 15m, trigger PD.
billing-bot: [automated] Billing queue: 14 waiting, avg latency 9s. Last full invoice run: 2026-03-20T21:00Z.
vendor_ali: CSV uploaded: s3://vendor-exports/new_ratecard_223333.csv  sha256: d2d2f9a6f... (truncated). LMK if you need JSON format.
sam_billing: Got CSV. Importing into `price_migration_v223`. I added `grandfather_exempt` flagged rows for the GDrive list link https://drive.redwood/drive/1gX...
carmen_cs: Confirmed list matches prod IDs. CS will withhold go if any mismatch.
tess_fin: Rollback criteria proposed: - invoice delta >4% across canary set vs baseline in 20m OR - `billing.meter_missing_total` >0.3% OR - any exempt acct hit with NEW_RATE. If any trip -> immediate 0% weight + manual review.
raj_sre: Will attach runbook link for rollback steps. Also recommend a short blackout on downstream invoice exports for the canary window to avoid partial exports.
sam_billing: Simulated invoice results: no exempt acct charged, random PAYG samples show <1% delta. No meter mismatches in the first 1000 simulated events. Uploading report to GDrive.
tess_fin: Thanks. CS and Billing to confirm go/no-go 08:30 PT tomorrow. I'll hold final flip. :thumbsup:
